column1: lion|/ˈlaɪən/|动物|n. 狮子|The lion rests under the big tree at noon.|狮子中午在大树下休息。
sheep|/ʃiːp/|动物|n. 绵羊|The white sheep eats grass near the green hill.|白色的绵羊在青山旁吃草。
snake|/sneɪk/|动物|n. 蛇|The long snake moves slowly on the warm ground.|长蛇在温暖的地面上慢慢移动。
frog|/frɒɡ/|动物|n. 青蛙|A small frog jumps into the pond after the rain.|雨后一只小青蛙跳进池塘。
chicken|/ˈtʃɪkɪn/|饮食|n. 鸡肉；小鸡|We eat chicken and rice for dinner today.|我们今天晚餐吃鸡肉和米饭。
grape|/ɡreɪp/|饮食|n. 葡萄|She puts purple grapes in a small yellow bowl.|她把紫葡萄放进黄色小碗里。
pear|/peə(r)/|饮食|n. 梨|He eats a sweet pear after his lunch at school.|他放学午餐后吃一个甜梨。
cheese|/tʃiːz/|饮食|n. 奶酪|The mouse eats a piece of cheese on the plate.|老鼠吃了盘子里的一块奶酪。
uncle|/ˈʌŋkl/|家人|n. 叔叔；舅舅|My uncle drives a red car to our house.|我叔叔开红车来我们家。
aunt|/ɑːnt/|家人|n. 姑姑；阿姨|My aunt gives me a book for my birthday.|我姑姑送我一本书当生日礼物。
cousin|/ˈkʌzn/|家人|n. 堂表兄弟姐妹|My cousin and I play games after school.|我和堂兄放学后一起玩游戏。
arm|/ɑːm/|身体|n. 手臂|She raises her left arm to answer the question.|她举起左臂回答问题。
finger|/ˈfɪŋɡə(r)/|身体|n. 手指|He points to the picture with his small finger.|他用小手指着那幅画。
tooth|/tuːθ/|身体|n. 牙齿|The white tooth helps you eat the hard apple.|白牙齿帮你啃硬苹果。
knee|/niː/|身体|n. 膝盖|He falls and hurts his left knee on the ground.|他摔倒在地上磕伤了左膝。
crayon|/ˈkreɪən/|学习用品|n. 蜡笔|She draws a cat with a red crayon on paper.|她用红蜡笔在纸上画只猫。
notebook|/ˈnəʊtbʊk/|学习用品|n. 笔记本|I write new words in my blue notebook each day.|我每天在蓝笔记本上写新词。
chalk|/tʃɔːk/|学习用品|n. 粉笔|The teacher writes with white chalk on the board.|老师用白粉笔在黑板上写字。
purple|/ˈpɜːpl/|颜色|adj. 紫色的|She wears a purple dress to the school party.|她穿紫色连衣裙去学校派对。
gray|/ɡreɪ/|颜色|adj. 灰色的|A gray cloud covers the sky before the rain.|乌云在下雨前遮住了天空。
cry|/kraɪ/|动作|v. 哭|The little baby begins to cry in the quiet room.|小宝宝在安静的房间里哭起来。
cut|/kʌt/|动作|v. 剪；切|She cuts the paper with small scissors at school.|她在学校用剪刀剪纸。
fly|/flaɪ/|动作|v. 飞|The white bird can fly high above the green trees.|白鸟能在绿树上方高飞。
kick|/kɪk/|动作|v. 踢|The boy likes to kick the ball in the playground.|男孩喜欢在操场踢球。
laugh|/lɑːf/|动作|v. 笑|We laugh at the funny story during the class.|我们在课上为有趣故事发笑。
cute|/kjuːt/|形容词|adj. 可爱的|The cute dog sits beside the little girl.|可爱的小狗坐在小女孩身边。
pretty|/ˈprɪti/|形容词|adj. 漂亮的|She wears a pretty skirt to the spring festival.|她穿漂亮短裙去春季节日。
soft|/sɒft/|形容词|adj. 柔软的|The soft pillow feels nice on my tired head.|软枕头枕着疲倦的头很舒服。
warm|/wɔːm/|形容词|adj. 温暖的|The warm sun makes the small cat feel sleepy.|温暖的阳光让小猫昏昏欲睡。
smart|/smɑːt/|形容词|adj. 聪明的|The smart student answers the hard question fast.|聪明的学生很快答出难题。
